function.name: i2ccfg
function.description: Configure I2C clock speed. baudrate is in kHz (100 = 100kHz, 400 = 400kHz, 1000 = 1MHz).

function.name: i2cwr
function.description: Write and optionally read data from an I2C device. Returns 1 if successful.

arrayWrite.description: Array of bytes to send (can be empty)

arrayRead.description: Array buffer to read into (defines read length)
